POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order at 3:01 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56526  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee Meeting of
  Monday July 7, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

2.  25-56527  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the 2025 Homeless Services
  Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy Recommendation to the Mayor and City
  Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0 None

  Page 1 of 3
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 22, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. LONG BEACH, CA 90810

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Chotiswatdi

  • Chair Sarah Bedy and Julie Lie shared updates regarding the
  policy recommendations from their meeting with council members. They
  suggested that CoC Representative Scott ask service providers if any would
  be willing to pilot a program incorporating showers and toilets at their facility.
  • The subcommittee would like to gather more information from staff regarding
  the optimal location in the city for a pilot program featuring a portable shower
  and restroom. They believe that establishing the program in conjunction with
  the Mobile Access Center or in areas near downtown Long Beach would
  provide essential shower and restroom access to individuals experiencing
  homelessness.
  • Staff and the subcommittee discussed an amendment proposed to the policy
  recommendation made by the City Manager’s office. The subcommittee
  recommended keeping only the first sentence and removing the remainder of
  the paragraph.

3.  25-56529  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion of future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • The subcommittee will review and discuss the feedback that CoC
  representative Scott brings back from the meeting.
  • Follow up discussion on HSAC representatives’ meetings with council
  members.
  • The subcommittee would like to explore the option of using the Mayor’s Fund
  to support Phase One of a pilot program, the funds would be used to cover
  gap needs for the program. Staff will work with the subcommittee to explore
  options.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.
